protocol.method: Finite-horizon, sample-based fitted afterstate Q iteration with hierarchical shrinkage
protocol.trainingDesign: Sample 12,000 market seeds with replacement within each replicate's own 12,000-seed block; cross each draw with all training stems and both closings. Fit both estimators to these identical public offer tapes.
protocol.selection: Single fixed fitting rule. Release both final seed-13 models irrespective of validation and test scores.
protocol.inputs: Both models use the stage, truck count, signed offer and complete currently posted board. The history model further conditions on the latest three previous high/low outcomes, the earlier survey band, and an older high count.
protocol.reversalPlanner: On fresh reversals pooled equally across stems and endings, the lower paired 95% confidence bound for history RL minus the released distribution planner must exceed zero.
protocol.reversalHistory: On that same reversal set, the lower paired 95% bound for history RL minus the independently refitted no-history model must exceed zero.
protocol.retention: On pooled fresh interrupted drops and on EACH of three archived interrupted-drop families using fresh seeds, lower paired bounds must exceed zero against the distribution planner and minus one credit against BOTH previously released RL agents (Turns and Drift).
protocol.joint: Require both reversal checks, fresh-drop retention and every archived drop guard to pass. The ending-specific and individual-stem results are descriptive.
protocol.uncertainty: Two-sided paired percentile intervals resample complete scenario seeds including associated stems, hot/cold counterparts and policies. Intervals condition on the released fit and fixed patterns. Diagnostic intervals are unadjusted.
